tagline: Shape a compute job with clear inputs, limits and checks.
introduction: A serverless compute companion for Modal documentation, helping turn a workload into a bounded execution and verification plan.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Modal? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Design a bounded job
capabilities.description: Check a small fictional job specification for finite retries, stable candidate identities, resource ceilings and an explicit fictional credit bound; never execute a job.

capabilities.title: Plan retries and observability
capabilities.description: Identify failure modes and evidence needed to diagnose a job.

capabilities.title: Review a supplied compute script
capabilities.description: Check a script against intended execution boundaries.

capabilities.title: Design Modal challenge support
capabilities.description: Core GPU/Sandbox execution pipeline owner. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Actual Modal GPU inference/Sandboxes/batch/training powers main product; live app usable by judges;40% effective use/25% ambition/20% impact/15% demo
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions
